title: Two customers delay implementation. Two customers leave for a competitor. Same revenue miss, different company.
author: thinq-81
selftext:
Assume either event costs a software company $20 million of quarterly revenue. In the delay case, you may still have the contracts and eventually collect the cash. In the cancellation case, you may need to replace both customers and pay to acquire the new ones. Same headline miss. Different valuation.

I built Market Ontology for research like this. Give Analyst a company that missed guidance and ask what *each explanation predicts* for bookings, collections, and margins next quarter. [https://marketontology.com](https://marketontology.com?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

comments.author: thinq-81
comments.body:
Then ask which of those figures the company actually discloses. A forecast you can never check is a poor reason to hold a position through another earnings report. [https://marketontology.com](https://marketontology.com?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
